from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowFinancingRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of cash flow from financing activities found in a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The registrant name as stated in the document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the statement")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the financing activities line item")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash flow")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt of the data point")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financing_activities: list[CashFlowFinancingRecord]
